epic.name: Overview and yield curve charts
unverifiedAssumptions: Verify the two headline rate cards fill in once rates are imported: the app assumes the overview's key rates can be told apart by their family (nominal vs inflation), spot type and a "10Y" tenor label. If the service names them differently, both cards will keep saying "No data" even though rates exist.

Verify the size of the daily change: the app assumes the service already sends the change in basis points. If it actually sends a percentage difference, a real move of a few basis points will show as something like "+0.0 bp".

Verify Across families shows four lines: the app assumes the curve list has exactly one Nominal, Real, Inflation and OIS curve for each rate type and segment. If OIS has no long-end forward curve, or the families are labelled differently, lines will be missing and wrongly reported as "No data has been imported".
